analysis:
The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md. The visible patch adds one table row at head line 1406 documenting `demandedLatestCheckpointMinimumTokens`, a paged complete-store effective-token floor for dense Qwen3.5/3.8. No executable code, authorization, attestation, encryption or wire behavior changes. The supplied base units (lines 2427-2980) are unchanged surrounding documentation: MiMo media decode accounting, Flint constraints, coordinator-serving channels, and invariants. I read them for contradictions with the threat model and found none that this PR introduced.

Relevant threat: T-041 (prefix-cache sharing and TTFT oracle, with the SSD tier's HMAC-keyed names, 30-minute TTL and authenticated-account cacheSalt). The new row describes a checkpoint-boundary policy that ends a range just below the prompt end when it saves at least the floor. That could affect which donations or checkpoints are stored, and so the at-rest and timing surface. The change is documentation of a policy in EngineV2Factory+DemandedCheckpoint.swift and prefix-cache.md#streamed-complete-checkpoints. Neither the code nor the anchor is in the supplied evidence. I could not verify whether the underlying code change keeps the per-donation gate, HMAC lookup tags, salt scoping or TTL unchanged. The docs add no claim that loosens those. That belongs to the code-side review of the source change, not a finding on this doc diff.

The truncated patch excerpt means I cannot rule out other doc edits, but the changed-range map is complete and shows only head line 1406. No findings.
